remarks: Welcome to 43 Glenville Street, a distinguished residence nestled in the heart of Greenwich. This elegant home was renovated in 2023 and recently painted inside and out. Upon entering, you are greeted by a spacious eat-in kitchen, featuring modern stainless appliances and granite countertops. The inviting living area is enhanced by a charming wood-burning stove, and the French sliding door leads to new English walnut deck. The main level boasts a primary bedroom with updated en-suite bathroom as well as 2 additional bedrooms and a full bathroom. Lower Level features a family room (or can be used as an extra bedroom), a wet bar area, an additional full bathroom, and laundry room. Lower level offers an additional 650sf of living space not included in the total.
